proposals.rationale: Construct a self-contained default reading for C0001 by incorporating the governing conditions of referenced clause (ii) (a single-employer plan in effect for a plan year beginning in 2007 with a positive balance in the funding standard account under section 1082(b) as in effect for and determined as of the end of that plan year) into the scope, logic, and summary.
proposals.quote: In the case of a single-employer plan described in clause (ii), the plan sponsor may elect to maintain a funding standard carryover balance, until such balance is reduced to zero.

scope_quotes: In the case of a single-employer plan described in clause (ii)

A plan is described in this clause if the plan—

(I) was in effect for a plan year beginning in 2007, and

(II) had a positive balance in the funding standard account under section 1082(b) of this title as in effect for such plan year and determined as of the end of such plan year.
